description: You can simply upload any image file and instantly share it with your colleagues: Introducing our PDF Image Gallery visual! You don't need to upload images to the Cloud or CDN; simply import your images directly into the visual. This visual boasts several impressive capabilities: It doesn't interact with external services, ensuring that your images are securely stored and encrypted within the report, consistent with your report's sensitivity settings. It automatically saves your selected image in preview mode, allowing your colleagues to view the exact image you have highlighted. Images can only be uploaded or removed in Edit Mode. Users in View Mode can only see the images.
